svg.title: Mission brief. Current mission: Building Sylvie — a local AI companion with contextual reasoning, intelligent memory and long-term behavioural evolution. Research interests: AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, LLM Engineering, RAG, Real-Time Voice AI, AI Memory Architectures, Computer Vision, System Architecture. Learning: Advanced AI Agents, Multi-Modal Systems, System Design, 3D Web & Creative Interfaces. Philosophy: Build. Explore. Learn. Share. Evolve.
